```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

This notebook is the interactive version of `scripts/01_run_pipeline.R`.
All paths and parameters come from `R/config.R`, so nothing here is machine-specific.
Put the three 10X `.h5` files in `data/raw/` before running.

# Load packages

```{r packages}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(hdf5r)
library(here)

source(here("R", "config.R"))
source(here("R", "utils.R"))
check_input_files(cfg)
```

# Load the female (batch 1), male (batch 2) and mixed (batch 3) datasets

```{r load-data}
# Each object is initialised from the raw (non-normalised) counts
F_namb <- load_sample("female", cfg); F_namb
M_namb <- load_sample("male",   cfg); M_namb
Namb   <- load_sample("mixed",  cfg); Namb
```

# Merge all batches

```{r merge}
chatall <- merge(
  F_namb,
  y = list(M_namb, Namb),
  add.cell.ids = cfg$cell_ids,
  project = "Chat_namb"
)
chatall[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(chatall, pattern = cfg$mt_pattern)
length(WhichCells(chatall))
```

# Quality control

```{r qc-violin}
VlnPlot(chatall,
        features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
        ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.001)
```

```{r qc-scatter}
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(chatall, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(chatall, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot1 + plot2
```

## Filter cells

```{r filter}
chatall <- subset(
  chatall,
  subset = nFeature_RNA > cfg$qc_min_features & percent.mt < cfg$qc_max_percent_mt
)
length(WhichCells(chatall))
```

# Normalise, find variable genes, scale

```{r normalise}
chatall <- NormalizeData(chatall)
```

```{r variable-features}
chatall <- FindVariableFeatures(chatall, selection.method = "vst",
                                nfeatures = cfg$n_variable_features)

# 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(chatall), 10)
top10

plot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(chatall)
LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
```

```{r scale}
all.genes <- rownames(chatall)
chatall <- ScaleData(chatall, features = all.genes)
length(WhichCells(chatall))
```

# PCA

```{r pca}
chatall <- RunPCA(chatall, features = VariableFeatures(object = chatall))
print(chatall[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)
```

```{r pca-plots}
VizDimLoadings(chatall, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca")
DimPlot(chatall, reduction = "pca")
DimHeatmap(chatall, dims = 1, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
DimHeatmap(chatall, dims = 1:12, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
```

## Dimensionality of the data

```{r elbow}
ElbowPlot(chatall)
```

# Clustering

```{r clustering}
x <- cfg$n_pcs
chatall <- FindNeighbors(chatall, dims = 1:x)
chatall <- FindClusters(chatall, resolution = cfg$cluster_resolution)
head(Idents(chatall), 5)
length(WhichCells(chatall))
chatall <- RunUMAP(chatall, dims = 1:x)
```

## Reorder clusters by relatedness

```{r cluster-tree}
chatall <- BuildClusterTree(chatall, reorder = TRUE, reorder.numeric = TRUE)
PlotClusterTree(chatall)
```

# Visualise the clusters

```{r umap}
DimPlot(chatall, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)
DimPlot(chatall, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, split.by = "orig.ident")
DimPlot(chatall, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, group.by = "orig.ident")
length(WhichCells(chatall))
```

sessionInfo()
